summary: In your first two years you take the listed required courses (with CSB 270 in the fall, winter and spring of years one and two), one chemical biology course, two CSB electives and one more elective. Each of these must be letter graded with a B- or better when a letter grade is offered; courses offered only S/NC, like CSB 399 research, count as they are. You need 135 units in all, and external credit is not accepted. An elective the Student Advisory Committee approves, or a writing course in place of BIOS 242 once you hold a fellowship, is moved in by hand. You check by hand the university's PhD requirements (described under Graduate Degrees, including the thesis defense), the quarterly ethics discussion and the accepted first-author article.
